name: Wolfpine Village Asset Candidate Ledger
purpose: Tracks generated or sourced candidate assets before promotion into the canonical Wolfpine Village kit.

source_policy.notes: Do not promote candidates into canonical asset paths until source, license/generation notes, cleanup status, and review status are recorded.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 01 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.
cleanup_notes: Crop with margin for alpha masking.
Normalize contact shadow to Batch 01 direction.
review_notes: Reject if door is blocked, missing, or visually ambiguous.
Reject if style is pixel-art or horror-dark.
Reject if facade cannot align with inn_front placement plan.

candidates.source_notes: Generate from Batch 01 prompt card. Record tool/model/date/settings before promotion.

Keep forge clutter beside the approach.
Normalize contact shadow to Batch 01 direction.
review_notes: Reject if forge clutter blocks the door.
Reject if chimney/forge identity is unreadable.
Reject if stairs lead to windows or dead platforms.
